---
# Copy this file to your-section/index.qmd to start a new page.
# It uses the shared page system (.pg-*) in _theme/theme.scss, theme "Galerie".
# The leading underscore makes Quarto skip this template when rendering.
# Rules and token tables are in STYLE-GUIDE.md.
pagetitle: "Section name - Thinh Ong"
description: "One short sentence describing the page."
page-layout: full
toc: false
comments: false
anchor-sections: false
# Page hue. It colours the title rule and marks the section in the menu.
#   hue-bl  logo blue  Home, About
#   hue-in  indigo     Research
#   hue-te  teal       Teaching
#   hue-cy  cyan       Software
#   hue-ma  mauve      Blog
body-classes: hue-in
---

```{=html}
<div class="pg">

  <!-- Page head. Title on the left, lead and links on the right.
       The stats block is optional: delete it if the page has no figures.
       "rise", "rise d1", "rise d2" give the short entrance on load. -->
  <header class="pg-head">
    <div class="pg-head__main">
      <p class="pg-eyebrow rise">Eyebrow label</p>
      <h1 class="pg-title rise d1">Page title</h1>
      <div class="pg-stats">
        <div class="pg-stat"><span class="pg-stat-label">Things</span><span class="pg-stat-num">6</span></div>
        <div class="pg-stat"><span class="pg-stat-label">Groups</span><span class="pg-stat-num">3</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="pg-head__aside rise d2">
      <p class="pg-lead">One or two short sentences that say what this page is.</p>
      <div class="pg-links"><a class="tl" href="https://example.org" target="_blank" rel="noopener">A link<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 17L17 7M8 7h9v9"/></svg></a></div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <!-- "On this page" row. One link per part. Give each link the hue of its part. -->
  <nav class="pg-toc" aria-label="On this page">
    <span class="pg-toc-h">On this page</span>
    <a class="hue-in" href="#part-one">Part one</a>
    <a class="hue-te" href="#part-two">Part two</a>
    <a class="hue-ma" href="#part-three">Part three</a>
  </nav>

  <!-- Parts. The hue cycles in the order indigo, teal, mauve, cyan (hue-in, hue-te, hue-ma, hue-cy),
       starting with the page's own hue. Every part needs a unique id. -->

  <!-- Part with lists of rows. Use <a class="pg-row"> when the row is a link. -->
  <section class="pg-part hue-in" id="part-one">
    <div class="pg-part__head">
      <div class="pg-part__line">
        <div class="pg-part__name"><span class="pg-num">01</span><h2 class="pg-sectitle">Part one</h2></div>
        <span class="pg-secsub">Optional short note</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <!-- List of works. Keep the label, the source and the year inside .r-sub: on a narrow list
         they sit on one line under the title, on a wide list each one gets its own column.
         Optional column widths: style="--col-pill: 152px; --col-meta: 230px; --col-year: 52px" on .pg-rows -->
    <div class="pg-rows">
      <a class="pg-row" href="https://example.org" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
        <span class="r-n">01</span>
        <span class="r-title r-title--lg">Title of the item</span>
        <span class="r-sub">
          <span class="r-pill"><span class="pill hue-in">Label</span></span>
          <span class="r-meta">Where it appeared</span>
          <span class="r-year">2026</span>
        </span>
        <svg class="r-arrow" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 17L17 7M8 7h9v9"/></svg>
      </a>
    </div>
    <!-- List with dates (roles, degrees). Add .r-amt as a fourth cell and use pg-rows--amt for amounts. -->
    <div class="pg-rows pg-rows--dated">
      <div class="pg-row">
        <span class="r-years">2024-2026</span>
        <span class="r-title">A row that is not a link</span>
        <span class="r-detail">First line of detail<small>Second line, in the muted colour</small></span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- Part with a tinted statement panel. -->
  <section class="pg-part hue-te" id="part-two">
    <div class="pg-part__head">
      <div class="pg-part__line">
        <div class="pg-part__name"><span class="pg-num">02</span><h2 class="pg-sectitle">Part two</h2></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel panel--tint">
      <span class="panel__label">Small label</span>
      <div class="panel__body">
        <p class="panel__lead">One statement in large light type.</p>
        <p class="panel__text">A short paragraph that supports it.</p>
        <div class="pills"><span class="pill hue-te">Tag one</span><span class="pill hue-te">Tag two</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- Part with cards. Each card has a tinted plate (an icon or a picture) and three text lines. -->
  <section class="pg-part hue-ma" id="part-three">
    <div class="pg-part__head">
      <div class="pg-part__line">
        <div class="pg-part__name"><span class="pg-num">03</span><h2 class="pg-sectitle">Part three</h2></div>
        <span class="pg-secsub">2 items</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="cards">
      <a class="card-g" href="https://example.org">
        <span class="plate"><svg class="ic" viewBox="0 0 120 80" aria-hidden="true"><circle class="l" cx="60" cy="40" r="22"/></svg></span>
        <span class="txt">
          <span class="meta"><b>Kind</b><span>May 2026</span></span>
          <span class="nm">Card title</span>
          <span class="tags">Tag, tag, tag</span>
        </span>
      </a>
      <a class="card-g" href="https://example.org">
        <span class="plate"><svg class="ic" viewBox="0 0 120 80" aria-hidden="true"><rect class="l2" x="30" y="18" width="60" height="44"/></svg></span>
        <span class="txt">
          <span class="meta"><b>Kind</b><span>2025</span></span>
          <span class="nm">Second card</span>
          <span class="tags">Tag, tag</span>
        </span>
      </a>
      <span aria-hidden="true"></span>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- Link to the next page. Give it the hue of the page it points to. -->
  <nav class="pg-next hue-te" aria-label="Next page">
    <a href="../teaching/index.html">
      <span class="nx-main"><span class="nx-label">Next page</span><span class="nx-title">Teaching</span></span>
      <span class="nx-text">One short line about that page.</span>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 17L17 7M8 7h9v9"/></svg>
    </a>
  </nav>

</div>
```
